order_additions.name: phone_confirmation_status
order_additions.description: NOT_CONTACTED, CONFIRMED or UNCONFIRMED; mandatory only for first unpaid order

order_additions.name: phone_confirmation_note
order_additions.description: Result/reason; no invented retry count or timeout

rules.BR-ORD-01: Only accept an order when every requested line has sufficient sellable on-hand stock less existing reservations. Reserve FEFO batches atomically with order creation; do not accept backorders.
rules.BR-FUL-01: Telephone confirmation is mandatory only for a first order whose goods payment is Unpaid. Store staff must obtain customer confirmation before approving that order; if confirmation cannot be obtained, staff may decide to cancel and release reservations. No automatic cancellation deadline or retry count is defined.
rules.BR-FUL-04: Record Delivery Failed separately from warehouse receipt. Warehouse Staff confirm all returned goods before Returned and the full-return refund path. Staff inspect goods and decide inventory disposition; the system records their decision. Inspection must not delay an otherwise eligible refund. Goods do not automatically become sellable on receipt.
rules.BR-FUL-05: For customer refusal due to product fault, the customer bears no delivery fee: refund captured goods and shipping amounts, or collect neither when unpaid. For confirmed deliberate refusal unrelated to product fault, refund captured goods only and retain the captured delivery fee for delivery-agent compensation; if goods were unpaid, the customer owes the delivery fee directly to the delivery agent. Record actual collection and compensation separately. Do not classify an unreachable customer as deliberate refusal automatically.
rules.BR-FUL-06: Automatic refund requires verified goods payment, confirmed complete physical return and a confirmed failure-cause category determining fee liability. Do not wait for warehouse quality inspection. Refund actual original collected allocations, not current prices. Provider request acceptance is not proof of completed refund. Unclassified/other causes remain unresolved; final cause-decision authority and payout integration are TBD.

requirements.FR-ORD-03: The system shall atomically validate and reserve sufficient sellable on-hand FEFO batch quantities for every order line while creating the order, rejecting the whole submission if any line is unavailable. Backorders are not accepted.
requirements.FR-MYO-01: The system shall show Pending Unpaid and Pending Paid as independent initial order states, then Confirmed, Packing, Shipping, Delivered, Cancelled, Delivery Failed and Returned, together with independent goods-payment, refund and shipping-fee collection information.
requirements.FR-FUL-02: The system shall require successful staff telephone confirmation before approving a first unpaid order. Paid first orders and repeat orders do not require that mandatory call. If the first unpaid order cannot be confirmed, store staff may cancel it with a recorded reason and release reservations.
requirements.FR-DEL-03: The system shall record failed delivery, its evidence and cause separately from physical return receipt, preserving the goods-payment state. A recorded failure alone shall not make stock available or confirm a completed refund.
requirements.FR-DEL-04: The system shall let Warehouse Staff record returned quantities against original order lines/batches and confirm complete receipt only when all shipped quantities match; incomplete receipts shall not enter the full-return refund path.
requirements.FR-DEL-05: The system shall record the reported failure cause, evidence and final cause confirmer/time; product fault and deliberate customer refusal have different shipping-fee consequences. The authority allowed to confirm the cause is TBD; no automatic blame classification is allowed.
requirements.FR-DEL-06: The system shall record customer shipping-fee liability, actual direct cash collection by the delivery agent, retained prepaid shipping fees and actual compensation paid to the agent separately. Shipping-only collection shall not mark goods as paid.
requirements.FR-DEL-07: The system shall record staff quality assessments and inventory-disposition quantities for returned goods, with staff/time/evidence. It shall apply only authorized inventory changes, without making this assessment a prerequisite for the customer refund.
requirements.FR-PAY-03: The system shall preserve verified payment receipts and their original goods/shipping allocations, channel and deduplication reference, and track goods-payment independently of fulfillment; select the initial Pending Unpaid or Pending Paid order state from verified payment at checkout, without a transition between these states.
requirements.FR-PAY-04: For a paid fully received failed-delivery return with a confirmed cause, the system shall automatically refund actual collected goods plus shipping for product fault, or actual goods only for deliberate refusal. Unpaid goods have no prepaid goods refund; product-fault customers owe no shipping fee.
requirements.FR-PAY-05: The system shall create at most one full-return refund obligation in the current scope, use idempotent payout references, track unresolved/failed payout separately, and mark partial/full refund only after verified settlement; outgoing integration remains TBD.

trace_rule_clarifications.BR-ORD-03: VietQR Automated Payment Matching: A verified SePay notification matching the order identifier and transferred amount >= order total changes PaymentStatus to Paid. Payment confirmation does not replace the independent fulfillment OrderStatus.
trace_rule_clarifications.BR-ORD-04: Order Cancellation Timeframe Constraint: Customers may cancel only Pending Unpaid, Pending Paid or Confirmed orders. Customer cancellation is blocked once Packing or Shipping begins. Other states do not grant customer cancellation eligibility.
